approved.fact: Male seahorses are the only males in the animal kingdom that get pregnant and give birth to their babies.
The immortal jellyfish can reverse its aging process from adult back to baby stage, essentially living forever.
Sharks existed on Earth hundreds of millions of years before trees evolved.
Caesar salad was invented in Tijuana, Mexico in 1924 by Italian-American restaurateur Caesar Cardini.
The breakfast burrito was invented in 1975 at Tia Sophia's restaurant in Santa Fe, New Mexico, not Mexico.
The first martini cocktail was created at New York's Knickerbocker Hotel specifically for John D. Rockefeller.
